paragraphs.source_en: When Nobuhira remarked in greeting upon how quickly Takechiyo had grown, Shinpachirō turned his face aside without answering. The Oda side seated Nobuhiro in the palanquin that had brought Takechiyo, making a respectable procession; the Matsudaira side, however, had only the fine horse Nobunaga had given Takechiyo.

paragraphs.source_en: Takechiyo’s party departed first. Shinpachirō’s nephew Tadayo led Takechiyo’s horse, Tadakatsu headed the party, and Shinpachirō brought up the rear as they left the temple. Hidden among the crowd, Takenouchi Hatarō smiled quietly.
